errors.text_span: Всички стойности са представени като точки, свързани с линии
errors.evidence: The chart does not show points/markers. It displays vertical stems extending from the x-axis to the data value's position, and these positions are connected by dashed lines. The description mischaracterizes this structure as 'points connected by lines' and fails to mention the dashed nature of the connecting lines.
The description lists several data points but omits the values for 2010 (49.8), 2011 (51.8), and 2013 (51.5), making the data summary incomplete.

errors.text_span: спад в стойностите от 2012 до 2018 г.
errors.evidence: Describing the trend from 2012 to 2018 as a 'decrease' is an over-generalization. While the overall trend in this period is downward, there was a slight increase from 43.7 in 2015 to 45.6 in 2016.
